intro.text: The capital of the honorspren in Shadesmar, the city where Syl grew up.
The honorspren capital in Shadesmar, a tall hollow fortress of blue stone on a cliff above the bay that mirrors Tukar.

description.text: The fortress is several hundred feet tall, a roofless rectangle of blue stone standing on end, with sheer windowless outer walls and battlements on top.
Inside, every wall has its own gravity, so buildings stand on all four inner walls, joined by stone walkways. Gardens on the southern wall keep Physical Realm trees alive with Stormlight.
Lasting Integrity cares for deadeyes found nearby, feeding them Stormlight, though it has to turn some away for lack of space.
It is governed by honorspren including six of the ten oldest, made by the Stormfather after the Recreance. Older honorspren want isolation; many younger ones want to join the war.

items.text: Syl grew up in Lasting Integrity and disliked it; after she slipped away to bond Kaladin, the honorspren offered a large reward for her return.
In 1174 the fortress closed its gates to nearly all outsiders, though the Herald Kalak came and went as he pleased.
In 1175, a delegation from Urithiru led by Adolin and Shallan came to ask the honorspren to bond humans again. Rebuffed, Adolin gave himself up to be tried for the Recreance.
The trial was held in the fortress's forum, with Kalak as High Judge.
On the last day, Maya spoke herself, declaring that the deadeyes had chosen to give up their bonds. Shocked, the honorspren left the forum.
After the trial, the isolation policy was dismantled, and the leaders' credibility was badly damaged.
